entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.>> O God, You [are] my God; Early will I seek You; My soul thirsts for You; My flesh longs for You In a dry and thirsty land Where there is no water.

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: So I have looked for You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and Your glory.

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: ¶Because Your lovingkindness [is] better than life, My lips shall praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: Thus I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness, And my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips.

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the [night] watches.

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: ¶Because You have been my help, Therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand upholds me.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those [who] seek my life, to destroy [it], Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They shall fall by the sword; They shall be a portion for jackals.

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king shall rejoice in God; Everyone who swears by Him shall glory; But the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
